items.q: Lombard -- Mr. L-o-m-b-a-r-t, and company, he had the Apollo in Paris... we played the Apollo... he come and said, 'Look, I want to send you boys for six months'

ctx.x: Well, Lombard -- Mr. L-o-m-b-a-r-t, and company, he had the Apollo in Paris. He turned that into a nightclub. And we played the Apollo. We played in that place.
Well, when we was finished with the Negresco Hotel, we played the Apollo. After the Apollo, he come and said, "Look, I want to send you boys for six months", I think, "into BA." Cause he had a --
